sloka: तच्छ्रुत्वा राक्षसेन्द्रेण विसृष्टा भृशदुर्जयाः ।राक्षसाः किङ्करा नाम रावणस्य मनोनुगाः ।। ५.५८.११३ ।।।।
transliteration: tacchrutvā rākṣasendreṇa visṛṣṭā bhṛśadurjayāḥ ।rākṣasāḥ kiṅkarā nāma rāvaṇasya manonugāḥ ।। 5.58.113 ।।।।

translations.english: "Ravana, lord of the demons having heard (the ogresses) sent invincible ogres called kinkaras who know his mind.
